name: Example Vault
description: A fictional yield vault used to demonstrate every field of the contract-metadata format. Not a real contract.
about:
## A fictional vault

Example Vault is **not a real contract**. It exists only to exercise every part of the contract-metadata schema in one document: ERC-7572 profile fields, audits, collaborators, validation rules, transaction value metadata, and extensions.

Depositors send ETH and receive exVLT shares; shares can be redeemed at any time. All numbers, addresses, and organizations in this file are invented.
risks: This document describes a fictional contract — the address is a placeholder and holds no code
Illustrative only: do not send funds to the example address

audits.scope: Core vault accounting and the exVLT share token

deposit.title: Deposit ETH
deposit.description: Deposit ETH into the vault and receive exVLT shares at the current share price.

value.label: deposit amount
value.description: ETH to deposit. The fictional vault enforces a 0.01 ETH minimum.

validation.message: Deposits below 0.01 ETH are rejected by the vault.

redeem.title: Redeem Shares
redeem.description: Burn exVLT shares and withdraw the corresponding amount of ETH.

validation.message: You must redeem at least one share.

setStrategy.title: Set Strategy
setStrategy.description: Point the vault at a new yield strategy. Owner only.
setStrategy.warning: Owner only. A malicious strategy can steal all vault funds.

memo.label: memo
memo.description: Short operator note recorded with the strategy change.

validation.message: Memo may only contain letters, numbers, spaces, and basic punctuation.

sharePrice.title: Share Price
sharePrice.description: The current ETH value of one exVLT share, as an 18-decimal fixed-point number.

donate.title: Donate to the Vault
donate.description: Deposit a fixed 0.05 ETH on behalf of the fictional community fund.

Deposited.description: Emitted when ETH is deposited and shares are minted.

Redeemed.description: Emitted when shares are burned and ETH is withdrawn.

DepositTooSmall.title: Deposit Too Small
DepositTooSmall.description: Deposits must be at least 0.01 ETH.

_examplecorp.note: Fictional root-level extension demonstrating the ^_[a-zA-Z] escape hatch.
